svg.aria-label: Wrong edges seeded into the graph, falsely confirmed by the grader
svg.title: Wrong edges seeded into the graph, falsely confirmed by the grader
svg.text: Seeded wrong edges the oracle grader falsely confirmed
seeded wrong edges across 34 compiler-graded cells in 7 languages (C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Rust,
TypeScript). Every cell grades a poisoned twin of its own export — each edge re-targeted to a declaration
the oracle never resolved that site to — and the grader refused or left unjudged every one; it confirmed
none.
Precision-against-oracle on the 53 compiler-graded cells (dagger's 19 Go modules counted one each):
50 at 100% — confirmed equals graded, 0 contradicted. The exceptions, printed because they are what make the number
believable:
header-heavy, the claim rule's hardest case; no contradiction left: scip-clang's eight wrong-specialisation
edges are withheld where the written qualifier contradicts them (ADR-125, C-153 narrowed), and its two remaining
C-153 rows sit unjudged on lines the key left unresolved, which the strict figure counts; the oracle's own
defects (H-28–H-32) are fixed, and C-155 is lifted
leaf (Rust): 1,590/1,634 = 97.3% — the first random Rust draw; its 44 contradicted are one cfg twin's lines
(C-182): the node sits at the uncompiled openssl arm
quic-go (Go): 3,766/3,781 = 99.6% — random draw; binary roots only (the full test program OOM-killed the box);
all 15 contradictions are the test build's shadowing methods, 0 hobbes-wrong
Trace-graded cells (Python — the interpreter under the repo's own suite): 0 of 25,580 seeded wrong edges falsely
confirmed across 5 cells. A refusal there is 'suspect', never a contradiction: the interpreter confirms and cannot
contradict (C-60), so those cells are kept out of the headline sum.
Not in the sum: dagger — the record quotes the poison check per module and does not sum it (the module table's regrade
block states the sum).
Precision-against-oracle is a lower bound: contradictions mostly triage to the oracle's own grain, and the triage ratio is
quoted per cell (A-8).
Every number is read from docs/oracle/cells/ by bench/oracle/report/render.py (ADR-102); the answer keys are compilers Hobbes does not
control (ADR-089): x/tools RTA for Go, tsc for TypeScript and JavaScript, rustc's MIR for Rust, javac with CHA for Java, clang's front end
for C and C++.
